description: Fix critical TypeScript errors blocking build: rate limiter API mismatch (7 errors in auth.ts, tests), seed-demo.ts teamId nullability (1 error), scope.test.ts readonly array mismatch (2 errors). Total 20 errors preventing compilation.
steps: 1. Read lib/rate-limit.ts and identify the correct API signature. Current errors show rateLimit() called with 3 args but function expects different signature returning {ok, retryAfterSec} vs {check, success, remaining, reset}.
2. Fix app/actions/auth.ts lines 25-27, 44: Update rateLimit() calls in loginAction and forgotPasswordAction to match actual API. Replace .ok checks with correct property.
3. Fix tests/phases-9-12.test.ts lines 9, 185-190: Update import (remove resetRateLimits if not exported), fix rateLimit() calls to use correct signature and properties.
4. Fix prisma/seed-demo.ts line 86: Ensure teamId is non-null for users that require it, or update the type expectation to allow null.
5. Fix tests/scope.test.ts lines 41-42: Change readonly array literals to mutable by using Array.from() or as string[] cast, or update DataScope type to accept readonly arrays.
6. Run npm run typecheck to verify all 20 errors are resolved.
